currentParagraphText: “Why sorry?” the False God asked, seemingly having not even noticed Jake yet as it only focused on Jacob.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “Why sorry?” the False God asked, seemingly having not even noticed Jake yet as it only focused on Jacob.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: Jacob didn’t answer but just looked past the Desolate Child of Loss. The False God took a little before it followed his gaze and saw Jake floating in the air. The moment it laid eyes on Jake, its entire demeanor changed in an instant.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: And why wasn’t it attacking him but instead looking at him with confusion.
